Prep: 15–20 minutes
Cooking time: 1½ hours|difficulty=2 }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Legumes|Beans]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]] ==Ingredients== * 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cranberry or pinto beans * 1 cup [[Cookbook:Spelt|spelt]] or [[Cookbook:Wheat|wheat berries]] (available at gourmet-food shops) * ¼ cup extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]], plus more for drizzling * ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] sweet Italian [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausage]], casings removed * 1 pound [[Cookbook:Kale|kale]], preferably Tuscan, coarse stems removed, cut into thick ribbons * 1 medium-large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] * 1 large [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], peeled and diced * 1 large rib [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], trimmed and diced * 3 [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] * 5 cups homemade [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]], or canned low-sodium stock, plus more if needed * 1 cup peeled, seeded, and diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], or drained canned diced tomatoes * 1 sprig fresh [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]] * 1 sprig fresh [[Cookbook:Sage|sage]] * [[Cookbook:Salt|Sea salt]] and freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] * ½ cup freshly grated [[Cookbook:Cheese|Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese]] ==Procedure== # [[Cookbook:Soaking Beans|Soak]] beans and spelt overnight in separate bowls of cold water. # Drain and set aside. # Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. # Add sausage. # Cook stirring occasionally, until meat begins to separate and brown (3–5 minutes). # Stir in kale, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic. # Cook until softened (about 10 minutes). # Add beans, spelt, chicken stock, and tomatoes. # Bring to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. # Stir in rosemary and sage. # Reduce heat. # [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] mixture for 60–70 minutes, until beans are tender; if soup is too thick, add chicken stock. # Season to taste with salt and pepper. # [[Cookbook:Ladle|Ladle]] soup into bowls. # Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle on cheese. # Serve immediately. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * Have this soup first with bread, like [[Cookbook:Ciabatta|ciabatta]], then finish with some cold cuts, like [[Cookbook:Salami|salami]] and [[Cookbook:Prosciutto|prosciutto]]. * Instead of using spelt, you can substitute [[Cookbook:Barley|barley]]. * If you can't find Tuscan kale, you can use regular kale, [[Cookbook:Mustard Greens|mustard greens]], or [[Cookbook:Swiss Chard|Swiss chard]]. * This soup tastes even better the next day.
